name: What should I prepare before hiring a contractor to finish my basement?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before hiring a contractor to finish my basement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before meeting with a contractor, clearly define how you want to use the basement, such as for a home theater, guest bedroom, gym, or rental suite. Note the locations of your furnace, water heater, main electrical panel, and existing plumbing rough-ins, as these anchor your floor plan. Check your concrete foundation and slab for any past water intrusion, dampness, or cracks that need sealing prior to construction. It is also helpful to establish a preliminary budget and collect reference photos of your preferred trim style, lighting, and bathroom finishes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Identify your intended room uses, note existing mechanicals and plumbing rough-ins, check for moisture issues, and establish your budget before meeting.
